title: Follow my answer: the owner reads the card, then paraphrases the next one; no follow card, the points are struck

utterances.speaker: Ingrid
utterances.text: Can you tell me about yourself and your background?

utterances.speaker: the owner
utterances.text: Sure, I'll give you the short version of what I've worked on. I led Lantern, an LLM pipeline that extracts structured fields from supplier invoices. Lantern cut manual data entry from eleven minutes to two minutes per invoice.

utterances.speaker: the owner
utterances.text: The big win was speed. People used to spend something like eleven minutes on each invoice and now it's about two. And the models cost roughly nineteen hundred euros a month.
